user_model_brief: Single-user Meta-internal tool (Anshul Verma, SWE@Meta). Prefers 'do it now, avoid future migrations'. Pluggable providers via dynamic import + typed ProviderConfig; Composite* providers route by source_type with default fallback; repository pattern. Doc split: foundational in workbench/, Meta overlay in workbench-meta/. asyncio.create_subprocess_exec for all subprocess. Bearer auth except /health. UI pure HTTP client, HashRouter, shadcn/ui+Tailwind v4+React19+Vite+TanStack Query, npm-blocked build via /tmp Node v20. Config write-back YAML (ruamel)+hot-reload per ADR 0013. Noise filter via LLM judgment not regex. meta CLI needs THRIFT_TLS cert.
